title: Verifier-driven escalation: learn from a real 'did it work' signal per step
goal: Today the brain learns from 'answered' and from mission outcome. Add a per-step verifier hook (compile/tests/contract verdict from the caller) that records a verdict for the provider that produced that step and escalates to a stronger provider when the verifier rejects, capped and evidence-recorded. Must add tests named verifier_escalation_* proving: reject -> next-best provider tried; accept -> recorded once; cap reached -> stops.
